DIRECTIVE: Honestly narrow `thm:certified-dynamic-program` to an \(\varepsilon\)-certificate/convergence theorem with no advertised closed-form mesh sizes or complexity bound. Use a deterministic nested finite search over score boxes, guard boxes, time/allocation meshes, Gaussian-cell partitions, prior nets, and arithmetic precision; prove termination by a direct finite-horizon uniform-continuity induction for the regularized Bellman operators. Do not invoke Barles–Jakobsen as a substitute for this induction.

For boundary handling, compute on an enlarged guard box and use \([0,1]\) only outside it; charge its effect solely through a certified uniform probability of leaving the guard box, never through an unproved clamping extension. For each state cell, define the multilinear interval interpolant as the barycentric sum of vertex intervals widened by a computable Bellman-value oscillation modulus at that cell diameter; derive the modulus recursively from the regularized terminal payoff and the explicit Gaussian kernel, including the allocation/control mesh error. For each truncated Gaussian cell, outward-round its probability and enclose the entire image of the cell under the transition map, multiply that probability interval by the corresponding continuation interval, and assign the omitted Gaussian tail adversarially in \([0,1]\). Evaluate every point-mass-prior oracle with this same validated recursion and certified rational primal/dual LP bounds. Independently re-evaluate the returned policy mixture by a fixed-policy interval recursion—do not reuse its optimization objective—and then extend its scenario risks from the prior net using the already proved Lipschitz prior bound.

Maintain a ledger whose entries are the regularization, guard-exit, interpolation/control-mesh, Gaussian-cell, Gaussian-tail, oracle/LP, recovered-policy, prior-net, and rounding contributions as applicable; accept a refinement only when the sum of the actual certified bounds is at most \(\varepsilon\) (or each fits its already frozen advertised slot). Uniform convergence makes this finite search terminate. If the field-level theorem presently asserts the unsupported explicit mesh formulas or a rate, remove only those assertions; preserving them would require a new quantitative consistency theorem and therefore cannot be approved from the current assumptions.

Generalize the theorem layer from null-boundary-closed scenario sets to arbitrary finite H0 subset [-H,H]^K. The discharged proofs use only finiteness and bounded effects: the common-drift perturbation is a change-of-measure device, while terminal comparison, exact embedding, value transfer, finite-scenario separation, oracle evaluation, and certificate termination do not require closure. Remove ass:null-boundary-closure from the load-bearing assumptions and from every theorem dependency; revise def:certificate-instance so validity needs the exact finite scenario list but no null-boundary projection/incidence closure data. Retain null-boundary closure only as an optional application-design convention or corollary if useful. Re-prove or faithfully restate thm:boundary-stable-frontier, thm:least-favorable-saddle, and thm:certified-dynamic-program over arbitrary finite bounded H0. Synchronize tldr, project_justification, honest_scope, related_work, and theorem prose. Do not advertise zero allocation itself as novel; the contribution is boundary-stable discontinuous-payoff transfer and certification while allowing it. Keep least-favorable-prior duality as supporting architecture and keep off-origin generalized-terminal comparison OPEN.

Correct the proof of thm:boundary-stable-frontier at the adaptive likelihood second-moment step. Do not assert E_0[Z_m^2] = E_0 exp(sum_j (h_j^m)^2 Q_j), because the adaptive random clock Q is correlated with the stochastic exponential. Validity-only repair; do not attempt to raise the lost field ceiling. Let c_H=H+H^2/2. Retain Omega_delta(d)=min{1,(32/delta+2K c_H)d} only for the normalized posterior payoff. For the scaled unnormalized reference datum Sg, where S=(sum_m lambda_m Z_m)/C_G, define tilde-Omega_delta(d)=min{1,(32/delta+3K c_H)d}: g contributes 2K c_H d and S contributes K c_H d, while |Sg-S_prime g_prime| <= |g-g_prime|+|S-S_prime| because all factors lie in [0,1]. After selecting near-minimax pi_N, Markovize it under the zero-drift reference law. At stage i, with S_{i-1}=(X_{i-1},Q_{i-1}), define the regular conditional action kernel kappa_i(j|s)=P_0^{pi_N}(A_i=j | S_{i-1}=s). Implement these kernels using fresh external randomization, encoded in the permitted time-zero randomizer. Because the conditional Gaussian transition from S_{i-1} depends only on S_{i-1} and A_i, induction shows the Markov policy bar pi_N has the same joint (X_i,Q_i) marginal as pi_N at every decision time under P_0, hence the same terminal state law.

Do not claim Q encodes ordered action history; it records counts only. Hidden history and correlated randomization are integrated out by kappa_i, while (X,Q) suffices for the next transition and every scenario likelihood. Use E_m^pi[f(X_N,Q_N)] = E_0^pi[Z_m(X_N,Q_N) f(X_N,Q_N)]. Equality of reference terminal-state laws therefore gives equality of every declared scenario terminal-state law and risk vector for pi_N and bar pi_N, with no continuity assumption on f, so the discontinuous closed-test loss is preserved exactly.

Apply the block construction to these continuous Markov kernels, feeding the current block-boundary score-clock state. Budget kernel-regularization error inside epsilon before n tends to infinity.
